column1: # Dynamic equality must preserve value semantics for boxed strings.
# Empty object literals allocate dynamic objects so reflection can add fields.
# Std.isOfType lowers type expressions through the native runtime type ABI.
# An interface-typed value retains its concrete runtime class after array storage.
# Strings cross runtime boundaries as String objects carrying their length.
# String lengths count UTF-16 code units, including literals outside the BMP.
# Reflect reads and writes compiled class and anonymous record fields by name.
# Std.parseInt/parseFloat follow C strtol/strtod on every target.
# Array.pop and Array.shift return abstract elements intact.
# Std-port syntax: implicit enum abstract values, unqualified enum abstract cases, block initializers, @:isVar, iterator() loops.
# Xml parses, queries, and prints URDF-like documents.
# Xml reports parse errors with positions and edits node trees.
